# BTCUSD RESOLUTION_PLACEHOLDER Transformer Training

Trains one independent per-TF transformer. Shared modules: `feature_store/transformer_btcusd/`.

Exports: `metadata_transformer.json`, `btcusd_RESOLUTION_PLACEHOLDER_transformer.onnx`, `feature_config.json`
!pip install -q torch pandas numpy scikit-learn pyarrow onnx onnxruntime requests

from pathlib import Path
from scripts.colab.train_transformer_resolution import run_training

resolution = "RESOLUTION_PLACEHOLDER"
export_dir = Path("/content/export")  # Path("export") for local
epochs = None  # e.g. 5 for smoke test
history_days = None
raw_cache_path = Path(f"btcusd_{resolution}_raw.parquet")
refresh_data = False

run_training(
    resolution=resolution,
    export_dir=export_dir,
    epochs=epochs,
    history_days=history_days,
    raw_cache_path=raw_cache_path,
    refresh_data=refresh_data,
